plan.notes: Source: 'BA Mass Communication: TV/Sports Production - Suggested Plan of Study 2025-2026 Catalog' (Dempsey College of Liberal and Performing Arts, Department of Art and Design), official 2025-2026 SAU Undergraduate Catalog. Choice slots use the first-listed option's code with choice=true. The plan prints 'MM 3403 Producing Online Content' in Spring Semester 2 where program requirements list 'MM 3143' - kept verbatim. The plan prints 'MM 3403 Sports Production' in Spring Semester 4 - kept verbatim. The senior capstone choice 'MPRO 4342 Senior Capstone or MM 4903 Senior Research Project' is printed as 2-3 credits; the lower bound (2) is used per collection convention. Per-semester totals printed by the catalog (17/16/15/16/15/15/15/11-12) match the sequenced course sums using the lower bound; the catalog's program total of 120 matches the sequenced sum of 120. REPEATS: the SAU 2025-2026 catalog's own Suggested Plan of Study for BA Mass Communication: TV/Sports Production prints 'MM 3403 Producing Online Content' (Spring Semester 2) and 'MM 3403 Sports Production' (Spring Semester 4); kept verbatim as printed. Note the program requirements list identifies Producing Online Content as MM 3143. allow_repeated_courses set 2026-10-01.
